evidence.observation: Before growth, exhaust O2 was 2.0 ppm and pressure 2.973 Torr with Ar 99.8 sccm.
During growth, O2 rose to 11.4 ppm and pressure to 3.075 Torr.
O2 and pressure continued rising to 24.4 ppm and 3.199 Torr.
O2 reached 29.7 ppm and pressure 3.275 Torr despite Ar remaining on target at 100.1 sccm and T at 749.6 C; running status does not negate this atmospheric deviation.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-integrity check and exhaust-conductance check are needed to distinguish suspected air ingress through a seal from other pressure/oxygen disturbances; no sample characterization is available.
